deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; no late applications.
deadline.quote: The online application for Fall 2027 entry is now open. The deadline to apply is December 1, 2026.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for Fall 2027 entry.
gre_general.quote: Scores from the general or subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE) are not required for admission to the Bioengineering PhD or MS Program for Fall 2027 entry.

supervisor.value: First-year students rotate in three labs before choosing a dissertation advisor.
supervisor.quote: First-year students have the opportunity to rotate in three different labs before selecting their dissertation advisor (PI).

funding.value: Bioengineering is in the School of Engineering, which commits to full funding for all PhDs.
funding.quote: Stanford Engineering commits to full funding for all PhDs.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is the minimum requirement.
entry_route.quote: You must hold, or expect to hold before enrollment at Stanford, a U.S. bachelor’s degree or its international equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.

notes: Joint department of the Schools of Engineering and Medicine; applied separately from the Biosciences programs.
